generic_domain.justification: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is the broadest field among the provided research domains. It serves as an umbrella term that encompasses various specialized areas such as machine learning, deep learning, natural language processing, computer vision, and robotics. These subfields are all integral components of AI. The other domains listed, like mathematical modeling or mathematical modelling, are methodologies used within AI to solve complex problems but do not stand alone as separate top-level domains. Therefore, AI is the most generic and comprehensive domain that can cover all the others.
